sections.title: Great Fairies
sections.note: Seven Great Fairies and the Queen of Fairies. Each fairy leaves healing fairies behind once she's given her gift.

items.name: Great Fairy (Northern Fairy Island)
items.howTo: Walk into the fountain under the giant shell; nothing blocks it.
items.notes: The first of the two wallet fairies gives 1,000 Rupees, the second 5,000. Also in Items & Equipment, Upgrades.

items.name: Queen of Fairies
items.howTo: Warp to Mother and Child Isles with the Ballad of Gales (sailing can't get in) and meet her in the grotto.
items.after: After the second visit to the Forsaken Fortress

items.name: Great Fairy (Western Fairy Island)
items.howTo: Pound the stake by the shell with the Skull Hammer to put out the fire at the entrance.
items.notes: The first of the two quiver fairies gives 60 arrows, the second 99. Also in Items & Equipment, Upgrades.

items.name: Great Fairy (Eastern Fairy Island)
items.howTo: Blow up the rock beside the shell with a Bomb.
items.notes: The first of the two bomb fairies gives 60 Bombs, the second 99. Also in Items & Equipment, Upgrades.

items.name: Great Fairy (Thorned Fairy Island)
items.howTo: Pound the three stakes with the Skull Hammer to clear the thorns at the entrance.
items.notes: The first of the two quiver fairies gives 60 arrows, the second 99. Also in Items & Equipment, Upgrades.

items.name: Great Fairy (Southern Fairy Island)
items.howTo: Break the wooden wall with a Bomb or a Fire Arrow.
items.notes: The first of the two bomb fairies gives 60 Bombs, the second 99. Also in Items & Equipment, Upgrades.

items.name: Great Fairy (Outset Island)
items.howTo: Glide with the Deku Leaf to the Forest of Fairies (the bridge is broken) and blow up the rock over the fountain with a Bomb.
items.notes: The first of the two wallet fairies gives 1,000 Rupees, the second 5,000. Also in Items & Equipment, Upgrades.

items.name: Great Fairy (Two-Eye Reef)
items.howTo: Defeat the four-eyed Big Octo among the seagulls at the reef; the Great Fairy it held appears.
